title: Unsafe enum type coercion in cockpit tasks API routes
disprove_gate: Show that Prisma rejects invalid enum values gracefully with a 400 (it does not — it throws a 500 PrismaClientKnownRequestError)

title: Missing export const dynamic = force-dynamic on 4 API routes calling auth()
disprove_gate: Show that Next.js 14 App Router automatically opts all routes calling auth() into dynamic rendering without the explicit directive. True but explicit is still best practice and removes ambiguity for future caching headers.

title: Zero test coverage in packages/ingestion-pipeline — core pick generation pipeline untested
evidence: packages/ingestion-pipeline/src/process-sport.ts:processSport function is called by 2 critical paths (cron + admin trigger) with no test coverage
disprove_gate: Search for tests covering stableStringify or processSport anywhere in the test suite. Found: none.

title: Bootstrap: node_modules not installed — all tests and typecheck silently unreachable without npm ci
evidence: cmd:npm run typecheck (TS2305 errors due to missing Prisma client)
disprove_gate: Confirmed: npm ci --prefer-offline resolved the issue. No code change needed — environment cold start requires install step.

title: SYNTHESIS: ingestion-pipeline untested + zero guard coverage = silent regression surface for the most critical data path
evidence: Finding: processSport() called by cron/refresh-odds route and admin/trigger-refresh route
Finding: source-snapshot.ts stableStringify has complex logic (sorted key traversal, nested objects) that could silently break
INFERENCE: any regression in processSport gate propagation (isBootstrap, canPersistCanonicalHistory) would silently corrupt pick provenance
disprove_gate: Add tests that specifically verify isBootstrap is derived from gates.canPersistCanonicalHistory, not hardcoded. Test must fail if the derivation is broken.
